skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding fundamental principles of Vietnamese Criminal Law
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the basic principles of Vietnamese Criminal Law.
Students will be able to analyze specific criminal behaviors and determine if they constitute crimes.
Students will be able to determine legal consequences for criminal acts.
Students will develop skills in working in groups.
Students will improve their communication and presentation skills.
Students will develop the ability to independently study and accumulate knowledge.
Students will enhance their critical thinking abilities.
